create_stopwatch_instance: create a Stopwatch instance with a configurable window size for timing operations
reset_stopwatch: reset the Stopwatch to capture a fresh start time for new timing measurements
record_stopwatch_key: record elapsed time for a named key between consecutive Stopwatch calls
print_stopwatch_stats_mean: print the average elapsed time for each recorded key and total time
print_stopwatch_stats_latest: print the most recent elapsed time for each recorded key and total time
